title: Home practical guide and safety card: bicarbonate and vinegar
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 55 (Home practical guide and safety card: bicarbonate and vinegar (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 55: Chemistry review: reactions and calculations. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To observe a chemical reaction that makes a gas
safety: Eye protection if you have it
Never seal the bottle with a lid
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Work over a tray with an adult nearby
Pour about 3 cm of vinegar into the bottle
Use the funnel to put two spoons of bicarbonate of soda into the balloon
Stretch the balloon over the bottle neck, then lift it so the powder falls in
Watch the balloon; never seal the bottle with a lid
Record what happens; write the word equation

questions.q: Big question: where does the candle wax go?
questions.a: It reacts to make carbon dioxide and water vapour that escape; no mass is lost overall.
